scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Warning: this workspace expects pnpm — continuing anyway so hosts whose build pipeline runs npm install before delegating the real build to a pinned pnpm (see build:hostinger-npm) still work" >&2 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.build:hostinger: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/tapashub run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.build:hostinger-npm: npx --yes pnpm@10.33.0 install --frozen-lockfile && npx --yes pnpm@10.33.0 run typecheck && npx --yes pnpm@10.33.0 --filter @workspace/tapashub run build && npx --yes pnpm@10.33.0 --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
